serie: Loretta's Sunday Morning: an 81-year-old Iowa church lady reads one verse, one story and one prayer from her little book of fifty-two Sundays, at her own kitchen table and in her own front room
acciones: holding a small book open at the kitchen table, pouring coffee into a cup, a hand resting on a front door frame, setting out a plate, lighting a candle at the window, folding a dish towel
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain bottles and rags with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's 1950s white farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a small wooden cross on the wall, a worn wooden table, a wall calendar with pencil writing
lugares_fijos.puerta: the front door of Loretta's small white farmhouse: a wooden door with a glass window, a worn door frame, a porch light, a row of pale geraniums in a tin pot
lugares_fijos.sala: Loretta's front room: a plain couch with a crocheted throw, a window with a white lace curtain, a wooden radio, a small hymnal on a side table
lugares_fijos.iglesia: the fourth pew on the left by the window of a small Methodist church in Iowa: old varnished wood, a hymnal rack, morning light through old glass

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
